profile.summary: Michael Parkes is a researcher at UCL whose work focuses on developing computational methods for Background Oriented Schlieren (BOS) imaging. His research involves processing various image formats and using plenoptic/light-field cameras to create 3D understandings of chemical and physical changes in materials through density-sensitive imaging.

recent_work.title: Analysing 3D Background Orientated Schlieren Images
recent_work.description: A project focused on developing software to process images (JPEG, TIF, PNG) and video frames using the BOS method and plenoptic cameras to visualize density changes in 3D.
